messages.subject: Transfer shiny app from one shinyapps.io account to another
parts: Is it possible to transfer a shiny app from one account to another, without needing to republish or deploy it?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Transfer shiny app from one shinyapps.io account to another
parts:
Shaun,

I'm afraid this isn't something that is supported at the moment. The only way to move an application to a different account would be to redeploy it under that account. Keep in mind the new application will have a new URL.

-Andy
